about.title: About ZJU AutoLogin
about.text:
{app} v{version}
Auto keep-alive for the Zhejiang University campus network (Srun portal).

The protocol is reverse-engineered from the portal frontend. Project homepage:
{url}

Credentials never leave this machine. Licensed under MIT.
wiz.title: Initial Setup
wiz.intro: This tool re-authenticates the campus network automatically when the session expires, so remote desktop / SSH connections never drop.
wiz.detected_online: You are already online as {username}. The account has been filled in below — please confirm it and set the password.
wiz.detected_offline: Not authenticated right now. Enter your student ID and password.
wiz.detected_no_campus: Campus portal not detected. You can still finish the setup; it will take effect once you are on campus.
wiz.pwd_note: Your password is stored locally only (system credential manager) — never uploaded or synced.
wiz.autostart_hint: Launching at startup is recommended so the keep-alive survives reboots.
wiz.done_text:
All set! {app} is now keeping you connected.
It re-authenticates automatically; the tray icon shows status and manual actions anytime.
wiz.error_need: Please enter both account and password

portal.title: Connect another Srun portal
portal.result_ok: Detected: ac_id={acid}, local IP {ip}, challenge OK ✓ — save it, then fill your account in the main window
portal.result_fail: Detection failed: {msg}. Check the URL and make sure you are on that campus network
notify.keyword_hint: DingTalk/Feishu bots with keyword security: all push titles contain the word 校园网 — add that keyword in the bot settings. Webhook keys stay on this machine.
route.add_ok: Direct portal route added: auth traffic now bypasses VPN/TUN
route.add_fail: Route operation failed: confirm the UAC prompt and retry
route.hint: TUN-mode VPNs take over at the routing layer. This adds a persistent /32 route for the portal IP via your physical gateway (admin), so auth traffic bypasses the VPN. Remove it when switching networks.
route.remove_fail: Remove failed: confirm the UAC prompt and retry
err.user_must_modify_password: The portal requires a password change: update it on the portal first, then update it here
reconfig.title: Reconfigure
reconfig.confirm:

Continue?
reconfig.cleared: Credentials cleared; restarting into the setup wizard…

diag.title: Network Diagnosis
diag.proxy_advice: Portal auth bypasses proxies; if browser/updates fail, add a direct rule for the portal in your VPN
diag.portal_fail_advice: Check the cable/Wi-Fi is on the campus network; unreachable off-campus is expected
diag.offline_no_cred_advice: Save your account & password in settings/wizard
diag.login_test_limit_advice: Kick another device in Devices, or enable auto-kick
diag.login_test_cred_advice: Password may have changed: update it after changing on the portal
diag.login_test_other_advice: Portal rejected login; will retry. If persistent, copy diagnostics and report
diag.internet_fail_advice: Usually a campus egress/billing issue: wait or re-authenticate
diag.summary_all_ok: OK: portal reachable, authenticated, Internet fine
diag.summary_no_portal: Portal unreachable: not on campus or link down
diag.summary_limit: Device limit reached: kick another device
diag.summary_cred: Credentials rejected: password may have changed
diag.summary_no_internet: Authed but no Internet: campus-side issue
log.autokick: Device limit: auto-kicked oldest device {ip} (since {since}), re-logging in…
